meta.prompt: Show what is playing right now as an inline music card, playing at 1:14 into the track: Midnight City by M83, 4:03 long, with drawn album art, a progress bar with the elapsed time and the time remaining, previous, play or pause and next buttons, and a like button that reads "Like" and, once pressed, "Liked". Under it the next three tracks in the queue: Golden Hour, JVKE, 3:29; Ocean Eyes, Billie Eilish, 3:20; Electric Feel, MGMT, 3:49 (after those comes Dreams, Fleetwood Mac, 4:17). Next moves on to the following track from 0:00 and the queue moves up with it.
meta.text:
state playing=true
state liked=false
state pos=74
state queue=[{"title":"Golden Hour","artist":"JVKE","len":209},{"title":"Ocean Eyes","artist":"Billie Eilish","len":200},{"title":"Electric Feel","artist":"MGMT","len":229},{"title":"Dreams","artist":"Fleetwood Mac","len":257}]
state title="Midnight City"
state artist="M83"
state len=243
let remaining = len - pos
let elapsed = fixed(floor(pos/60),0) + ":" + (pos%60 < 10 ? "0" : "") + fixed(pos%60,0)

Card gap:12 w:390
  Row between
    Text.heading "Now playing"
    Badge.primary "{playing ? "Playing" : "Paused"}"
  Row gap:12
    Media kind:"skyline" tone:"dusk" w:64 h:64
    Column gap:2 grow
      Text.strong "{title}"
      Text.muted "{artist}"
  Column gap:6
    Progress =pos
    Row between
      Text.caption "{elapsed}"
      Text.caption "-{fixed(floor(remaining/60),0)}:{(remaining%60 < 10 ? "0" : "")}{fixed(remaining%60,0)}"
  Row center gap:16
    IconButton "skip_previous" -> pos=0
    IconButton "{playing ? "pause" : "play_arrow"}" -> playing=!playing
    IconButton "skip_next" -> pos=0; title=first(queue).title; artist=first(queue).artist; len=first(queue).len; queue=slice(queue,1,length(queue))
  Button.outline "{liked ? "Liked" : "Like"}" -> liked=!liked
  Divider
  SectionLabel "Up next" "{length(queue)} tracks"
  each t in queue
    Row between
      Column
        Text.strong "{t.title}"
        Text.muted "{t.artist}"
      Text.caption "{floor(t.len/60)}:{(t.len%60 < 10 ? "0" : "")}{t.len%60}"
